chapter: Compositions, singers and the end of the big band
title: Reassembling the big band for special dates
summary: Sammy Lowe rehearses the band for concerts such as Birmingham and a France festival.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Right. Do you still put the big band back together for special things?
Oh, yes. Oh, sure. I was, this past, this past May. Last May? Yeah. I did a concert in Birmingham at the big arena there. It was for 2 hours with the big band.
Now, Sammy Lowe, he went down in front of me with my chart, and rehearsed the

band and everything. So, when I, maybe, all I had to do was be there in time just for one rehearsal. He had the whole band set for me. I've done a few of those with Sam going out in front of me and get the band set up. He'd go down maybe a week ahead.

Then, well, I did, I went, well, I did a big band. I didn't have to get the big band together. I did a big band thing in France 2 years ago. It was over at the George Wein's Jazz Festival over there. I had my charts. But, I rehearsed the band, the jazz, the band that they had carried over there, here before going over. So, we was all set when I got there.

So, I'd love to get the big band then. In Birmingham, I had, what? Two fills, two drums. Sam go down there. I said my, my had everybody Six trumpets. Like (inaudible) in Birmingham, you know. But it was, and it sounded good.
And, where's your library now? You know, all fo the, you said you have how many books?
